list_currencies.code:
response = client.currencies.list_currencies({"search": "dollar", "active": True})
for currency in response.map["currencies"]:
    print(currency["id"], currency["code"], currency["name"], currency["conversion_rate"])
print(response.map["pagination"]["has_next"])

create_currency.code:
response = client.currencies.create_currency({
    "name": "Example Dollar",
    "code": "XEX",
    "symbol": "$",
    "country": "NZ",
    "conversion_rate": 1.2345,
    "precision": 2,
    "rounding": "nearest",
    "active": True,
}, transaction_no="TXN-IMPORT-0001")
print(response.map["currency"]["id"])

get_currency.code:
response = client.currencies.get_currency(1234, {"field_metadata": True})
currency = response.map["currency"]
print(currency["code"], currency["symbol"], currency["conversion_rate"], currency["base"])
print(response.map["field_metadata"]["rounding"]["options"])

update_currency.code:
response = client.currencies.update_currency(1234, {
    "name": "Example Dollar",
    "code": "XEX",
    "symbol": "$",
    "country": {"code": "US"},
    "conversion_rate": 1.5,
    "precision": 3,
    "rounding": "up",
    "active": False,
})
currency = response.map["currency"]
print(currency["country"]["code"], currency["conversion_rate"], currency["rounding"], currency["active"])

set_base_currency.code:
response = client.currencies.set_base_currency(1234)
base = response.map["currency"]
print(base["code"], base["base"])
print(response.map["previous_base"])
